title: REPEvent
description: A Resonance Event Protocol (REP) v1 acoustic incident event emitted by an edge sensor node.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event (UUID v4).

sensor_id.description: UUID of the sensor that generated this event.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of event onset, ISO 8601 with nanosecond precision where available.

timestamp_uncertainty_us.description: Estimated timing uncertainty in microseconds based on clock sync quality.

event_duration_ms.description: Duration of the detected acoustic event in milliseconds.

acoustic_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized feature vector. Used for deduplication and integrity.

feature_vector_version.description: Version string identifying the feature extraction algorithm.

peak_energy_db.description: Peak sound pressure level during the event in dB SPL.

impulse_score.description: Classifier confidence that this event is an impulsive acoustic incident.

environmental_noise_db.description: Estimated ambient noise floor at the time of the event in dB SPL.

snr_db.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the event (peak_energy_db minus environmental_noise_db).

sensor_health_score.description: Composite sensor health score at time of event (0=severely degraded, 100=nominal).

firmware_version.description: Firmware version string running on the edge node.

model_version.description: Acoustic model / feature extractor version string.

replay_nonce.description: Hex-encoded 16-byte random nonce for replay attack prevention.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical event payload.

received_late.description: True if this event was buffered offline and replayed after reconnection.

received_time.description: UTC timestamp when the core received this event. Set by core, not edge.

baseline_noise_db.description: Long-term learned noise floor for this hour-of-week bucket.

is_unusual.description: True if the event occurred during an unusually loud or quiet period.

features.description: Extracted acoustic feature vector. No raw PCM is included.

envelope.description: RMS energy envelope sampled in 10 ms frames over the event window.

spectrum_magnitude.description: FFT magnitude spectrum (2048-point Hann-windowed FFT, first 1025 bins).

mfcc.description: 13 Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (40 mel filters, 20-8000 Hz).

spectral_rolloff_hz.description: Spectral rolloff frequency in Hz (85% energy threshold).
